title: Claims Manual: Whole Life Insurance Death Claims, Proceeds and Payees
content:
## Coverage on the date of death

A claim on an Ashgrove Whole Life Insurance policy is covered when, on the date of death, the policy was in force, in grace, paid-up, reduced paid-up, or on extended term with the date of death on or before the extended term expiry date.

## Proof and approval

Death proceeds are disbursed only on a death claim whose certified death certificate has been received and whose request status is approved. Both facts are read from the death claim on file for the policy. Disbursement proceeds only while the policy status is death claim pending or claim paid.

## Contestability and suicide

A death within the tier's contestable period of the issue date, or of the reinstatement date for a reinstated policy, is approved only after contestable review, and a rescinded claim refunds premiums paid. Death by suicide within the tier's suicide exclusion period of the issue date pays only the premiums paid, which are the premium payments made by EFT, check, debit card, online bank payment, automatic premium loan or conversion credit since issue, less payments returned unpaid and less premium refunded as overpayment.

## Gross proceeds

Otherwise the gross proceeds are:

- the face amount in force (the reduced or extended face where a nonforfeiture option applies, or the graded benefit during a graded period),
- plus the paid-up additions face,
- plus dividend accumulations,
- less the loan balance and interest accrued to the date of death,
- less installments overdue at death,
- less any acceleration lien,
- plus premium paid for any period beyond the policy month of death.

## Interest and payees

Interest is added to each payee's share at the tier's death claim interest rate, simple, for actual calendar days from the date of death to disbursement over 365, rounded to the cent.

Proceeds go to the surviving primary beneficiaries of the designation in effect at death, by share. A predeceased primary's share passes pro rata to the surviving primaries, then to the contingents, then to the owner or the owner's estate. A minor's share, below the tier's minor beneficiary age, is paid only to a court-appointed guardian or UTMA custodian. A payee with a share of at least the tier's Beneficiary Access Account minimum may elect an Ashgrove Beneficiary Access Account.

## Worked claim (hypothetical, interest rate 3.5%)

Face 100000.00, paid-up additions face 6000.00, accumulations 2400.00, loan balance with interest to death 9000.00, no overdue installment, no lien, nothing prepaid beyond the month of death: gross proceeds 99400.00. Two primaries at 50% each; one predeceased, so the survivor takes the whole 99400.00. Disbursed 73 days after death: interest 99400.00 times 0.035 times 73, over 365, that is 695.80.
